value.rationale: An explicit complete classification of every optimal size-k leader set over an infinite two-community network family, strict exclusion of all mixed allocations, and an exact cubic phase boundary with nontrivial 2/3 asymptotic. The precise structural threshold matters for choosing the side on which to deploy limited noise-free sensors and can differ from the classical first-order optimum.
